notes.title: Bunker 9 Update
notes.content: [p]Dear Playtesters,[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to thank you for have taken the time to playtest Bunker 9 and provide us with valuable feedback. Your input has been incredibly helpful throughout the development process.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to the recent holiday period, our development activity has been limited, which is why there hasn’t been a new update for some time. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this pause.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re writing now to inform you that we are currently considering a new direction for Bunker 9. Specifically, we are exploring two potential paths for the game’s future development:[/p][list][*][p]A survival game with building mechanics, inspired by titles such as Valheim[i],[/i][/p][/*][*][p]An open-world RPG experience, focused more on exploration and progression, without building elements,[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re excited about the possibilities and will keep you informed as we move forward.[/p][p][/p][p]Regards, [/p][p]Melvin & Sven[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.10
notes.content:
[p]The following items have been either fixed or added: 

[/p][list][*][p] Players should now experience a significant FPS increase and noticeably lower GPU/CPU usage. Note: To fully benefit from these improvements, make sure to adjust the FPS Cap setting in the game menu.
[/p][/*][*][p] Possibly fixed a bug where zombies would stand still and stop responding until killed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.9
notes.content: [p]The following items have been either fixed or added: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a compass to the player's HUD to assist with orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 'death' marker to the compass to guide players back to their loot crate after dying.[/p][/*][*][p]Added world landmarks to improve player orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 'safe zone' to the bunker. As long as all players are inside, zombie waves will no longer spawn. Existing zombies will still attempt to attack players in the bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Added loot drops to zombies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a legend to certain UI screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new objectives to guide players in unlocking specific rooms within the bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Added help text indicating where crafted weapons are placed after using the workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]Added main menu text promoting team play.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the hunger gauge depletion rate from 1 to 0.5. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the thirst gauge depletion rate from 1 to 0.5. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the zombie horde spawn interval from 120–240 seconds to 300–420 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the 'Craft a Weapon' objective.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 'Unknown Transmission' objective would not always appear in the objective list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where open-world containers would sometimes have no items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dead zombie bodies would appear stretched.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some objectives would not correctly show as 'Failed' in the objectives list.[/p][/*][*][p]Potentially fixed an issue where zombies would sometimes stand still and stop attacking after a player dies or becomes untargetable. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.8
notes.content: [p]The following items have been either fixed or added: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added an "exit" sign to indicate the exit of the bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the width of the Main Menu sidebar to be more consistent with various resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where crafting and salvaging weapons would use/return insufficient materials.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it would be possible to have a negative amount of weight, permanently bugging the weight mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where target dummies in the Armory would not register shots properly. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.7
notes.content: [p]The following items have been either fixed or added: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a weight indicator in the inventory and container UI's.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a auto-save mechanic that occurs every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a manual save button for the server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where roaming zombies would not correctly agro the players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Ambient music. It now plays correctly in the morning and evening.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would be uncontrollable near the beach. [/p][/*][*][p]Re-ordered the stat-icons below the healthbar to be more intuitive. [/p][/*][/list]
